list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model AS __text, model AS __value FROM claude.api_calls WHERE model IS NOT NULL ORDER BY model

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(c.total_input_tokens),0) + coalesce(sum(c.output_tokens),0) AS total_tokens FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))
SELECT count(DISTINCT c.session_id) AS total_sessions FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))
SELECT count(*) AS total_api_calls FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))

SELECT round(sum(c.cache_read_tokens)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(c.total_input_tokens),0) * 100, 2) AS cache_read_pct FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))

SELECT coalesce(sum(s.duration_seconds),0) AS total_duration_seconds FROM claude.v_session_token_summary s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.first_event_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))))

SELECT round(avg(s.duration_seconds), 1) AS avg_duration_seconds FROM claude.v_session_token_summary s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.first_event_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))))

SELECT round(avg(c.delta_seconds), 1) AS avg_call_duration_seconds FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.called_at) AND c.call_index > 1 AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))

SELECT gs AS time, coalesce(sum(c.total_input_tokens),0) AS total_input_tokens, coalesce(sum(c.output_tokens),0) AS output_tokens FROM generate_series(date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '10 minutes' THEN interval '1 minute' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '30 minutes' THEN interval '2 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '1 hour' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '3 hours' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '12 hours' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '7 days' THEN interval '2 hours' ELSE interval '1 day' END) gs LEFT JOIN claude.api_calls c ON c.called_at >= gs AND c.called_at < gs + CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '10 minutes' THEN interval '1 minute' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '30 minutes' THEN interval '2 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '1 hour' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '3 hours' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '12 hours' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '7 days' THEN interval '2 hours' ELSE interval '1 day' END AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs

SELECT gs AS time, count(c.*) AS api_calls FROM generate_series(date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '10 minutes' THEN interval '1 minute' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '30 minutes' THEN interval '2 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '1 hour' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '3 hours' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '12 hours' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '7 days' THEN interval '2 hours' ELSE interval '1 day' END) gs LEFT JOIN claude.api_calls c ON c.called_at >= gs AND c.called_at < gs + CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '10 minutes' THEN interval '1 minute' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '30 minutes' THEN interval '2 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '1 hour' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '3 hours' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '12 hours' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz < interval '7 days' THEN interval '2 hours' ELSE interval '1 day' END AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY gs ORDER BY gs

SELECT s.session_id, s.ai_title, s.total_input_tokens, s.output_tokens, s.cache_read_pct, s.api_calls, s.duration_seconds FROM claude.v_session_token_summary s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.first_event_at) AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claude.api_calls c WHERE c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) ORDER BY s.first_event_at DESC
